structured.answer: The cheapest keren hishtalmut that follows the S&P 500 is at כלל, 0.48% a year from the savings and nothing from deposits. מנורה is close at 0.49%. I left out the new company אילון because it shows no fee yet and I don't know it.

stuck.why: The first company in the list is the most expensive. At first I thought it was the cheapest, until I read 'מהיקר לזול'
It sits under the cheapest one but says 'עוד לא דווח' instead of a fee, so I wasn't sure if it counts
